propositions: _build_jira_backend constructs an AcliClient with empty credentials when JIRA_URL, JIRA_USER, or JIRA_API_TOKEN are missing or whitespace-only, causing later API calls to fail with misleading 401/project-not-found errors instead of a clear configuration error
The Cloud adapter lacks a construction-time presence and format guard for credentials, creating a test-parity gap with the DC adapter which fails loudly at construction when JIRA_PAT is missing

JIRA_USER must be validated to contain an email address (local@domain format) at construction time, as Cloud authenticates using the Atlassian account email; a bare handle silently produces 401 errors

The test test_cloud_build_backend_with_missing_credentials_does_not_fail_loudly currently pins the silent-build behavior and must be flipped to assert that BackendEnvError is raised when credentials are absent
